description: This Java class implements an authentication provider for devices using username and password credentials, leveraging Hono's Credentials API. It extends a base credentials API class and includes functionality to extract credentials from JSON input, validate passwords with an encoder, and integrate with Vert.x for asynchronous processing.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordAuthProvider
classes.description: A provider class that verifies username and password credentials for devices via Hono's Credentials API, supporting asynchronous validation within Vert.x context.

methods.name: UsernamePasswordAuthProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Extracts username and password from provided JSON object to create credentials.

methods.name: doValidateCredentials
methods.description: Asynchronously validates the device credentials against stored credentials, using password hashing engine, within Vert.x context.
